what: What the aubio-to-madmom rhythm migration did to the show, measured.
why_committed: The investigation and sweep reports that justify this migration live under .superpowers/, which is gitignored — so without this file nothing in the repository records either the basis for the decision or its measured effect. See docs/migration-evidence.md for the prose.

pipeline.unchanged: aubio pvoc + 40-band Slaney mel filterbank (byte-identical, see filterbank_identical)

instrument: training/pipeline_digest.py, fast sim on a virtual clock, single thread

beat_source_basis.note: Why madmom was chosen. Decoded downbeat F1 on the 215-track validation split, measured by the beat-source sweep (decisions #81). NOT re-measured in this PR — quoted with provenance.
beat_source_basis.corpus: val-215, no subsampling, micro-averaged at +-70 ms

gate_faithful.description: flips median <= 1 per track — the stability a light show needs

caveats: Validation split only; no test read was taken.
Only madmom's ONLINE tracker was admitted — its offline path scores better and cannot run live.
The 'doubled F1' shorthand refers to the gate-faithful row (0.2701 -> 0.5013), not to max-F1.

hzIFjGcOKbg.mp3.split: eval_set / excluded_eval_set — held out of train, val and test

beat_stream_self_consistency.note: Emitted beat rate against the rate the source's own reported tempo implies. A tracker that disagrees with itself is dropping beats it has already counted.

PNpXKsge4xM.mp3.split: eval_set / excluded_eval_set — held out of train, val and test

whole_track_onset_rates_per_sec.note: aubio's onset stream against madmom's at the shipped threshold.

corpus_report_cache_regen_cpu_hours.basis: 1387 tracks, 156.6 audio-hours from clean_manifest.csv decoded durations

determinism_checksums_after.note: Byte-identical across two fresh processes per track.
